vibe: Infrastructure as Effects: type-safe, composable, and relentlessly correct.
highlights: Infrastructure-as-Effects (IaE) framework that unifies business logic and infrastructure config into a single type-safe program.
Resource Provider lifecycle operations (Diff, Read, Pre-Create, Reconcile, Delete, Capability) with strict contracts.
Binding.Service pattern for runtime capabilities, enabling circular dependencies and typed clients.
Idempotent Delete operations and careful handling of eventual consistency and retryable errors.
File system conventions enforce co-location of resource contracts and providers, with clear separation of capabilities.
assessment: This instruction file demonstrates exceptional engineering taste by treating infrastructure as a first-class, type-safe program. The emphasis on Effect's type system, composable retry logic, and explicit lifecycle operations ensures reliability and testability. The detailed conventions and anti-slop rules (e.g., idempotent deletes, stable properties) reflect a deep understanding of distributed systems and cloud provider quirks, making the framework robust and maintainable.
